title: Ego cannot deliver the peace it promises
summary: Ego cannot make peace; Naam cools what self-will inflames. Treat ego as illness, not identity.
takeaway: Treat ego as illness, not identity.
lifeApplication: When the face heats or the throat tightens, pause and refuse to grant ego the status of truth.

source.shortMeaning: Ego cannot make peace; Naam cools what self-will inflames.
source.lifeApplication: When self-will rises, take Naam before trying to win the moment.

evidence.coreClaim: Ego cannot make peace; Naam cools what self-will inflames.
evidence.turn: Let this stay with you: ego cannot make peace; Naam and service can.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the face heats or the throat tightens, pause and refuse to grant ego the status of truth.
